inputs.loader.bnt:
import Benitoite.Unofficial.IO.Process
import Benitoite.Unofficial.IO.Console
function main() -> Unit uses Process.Run, Console.Write
  bind cmd <- Process.Command(..Process.command(program: "sh", arguments: ["-c", "printf started > marker"]), environment: Map.fromList([Pair("LD_RUN_PATH", "dummy-value")]))
  match Process.run(cmd) with
  case Result.Ok(_) -> Console.writeLine("unexpected success")
  case Result.Error(error) ->
    if IOError.kind(error) = IOErrorKind.InvalidInput then
      Console.writeLine(IOError.message(error))
    else
      Console.writeLine("unexpected error kind")
    end if
  end match
end function
